policy: Reference-only visual analysis; proposed Plexus translations are design interpretations, not runtime or semantic authority.

assets.title: Glyphs and state vocabulary
assets.observed: Desktop board combines glyph columns, labeled states, progress variants, proof components and an 8px grid.
assets.translation: Use text plus a small icon for work state; keep selection, source age and reduced motion independent.
assets.avoid: Dense telemetry footers, display-scale type and ornamental orbit rings.

assets.title: Mission control and next action
assets.observed: Portrait screen has a next-action panel, four-step timeline, state rows, proof rows and two bottom actions.
assets.translation: Today gets one clear next action; Projects and Team use a list with bounded detail. Translate mission and dispatch into member work language.
assets.avoid: Large repeated hero cards, particle illustrations treated as data and mobile tab rails copied to macOS.

assets.title: Motion storyboard
assets.observed: Five three-frame sequences describe selection, progress, proof, packet arrival and attention, with reduced-motion variants. Exact durations are absent.
assets.translation: Keep event feedback local to the changed control. The 120–180ms timing is a Plexus design choice, with a static reduced-motion equivalent.
assets.avoid: Infinite breathing, ambient packet drift and motion presented as freshness evidence.

assets.title: Atlas and flat inspector
assets.observed: An asymmetric 2.5D object overview sits beside a flat node view, progress/count and owner list.
assets.translation: Translate the composition into searchable content plus a 300–340px inspector. Selection updates detail without losing work context.
assets.avoid: A permanent spatial map, decorative counts and inferred runtime relationships.

assets.title: Token and control board
assets.observed: Board labels deep teal, mint, chartreuse, paper, purple and peach roles, an 8px base grid, radii, control states and empty/loading/error panels.
assets.translation: Keep teal/mint/chartreuse roles, system sans, 13px body text, 4/8/12/16/24/32 spacing and modest housings.
assets.avoid: Oversized condensed headings, topology backgrounds, scanlines and unreadable microtext.

assets.title: Commands with 27-hour source age
assets.observed: Command rows show slash actions and explanatory subtitles. The screen displays LIVE beside derived 27h ago.
assets.translation: Clio may borrow concise action rows. Show connection, exact last successful read, source age and action permission separately.
assets.avoid: Calling cached data live, or exposing founder infrastructure commands as member navigation.

assets.title: Commands with 166-hour source age
assets.observed: The nearly identical command list shows derived 166h ago. Header/footer clipping limits layout conclusions.
assets.translation: Use this as a stale-content counterexample. Keep prior content visible with its timestamp and a refresh outcome.
assets.avoid: Treating crop geometry as canonical, or freshness labels as proof of a working connection.

assets.title: Mobile glyph grid, variant 1
assets.observed: Two-column glyph and state grids pair names with short descriptions and status pills.
assets.translation: Use compact icon/title/description rows and a responsive grid only when content benefits from comparison.
assets.avoid: A glyph gallery as the main member destination and 3D imagery in Identity.

assets.title: Mobile glyph grid, variant 2
assets.observed: Cropped header; flatter Taste/Ops outlines, dashed Proof/Gate housings and alternate selected/complete symbols.
assets.translation: Keep labels stable while visual state treatments vary. Variant meaning is unproven by the image.
assets.avoid: Assigning loading, stale or reduced-motion semantics from a dashed border alone.

assets.title: Mobile glyph grid, variant 3
assets.observed: Fuller header and simplified glyph treatments resemble variant 2; derived just now is a displayed label.
assets.translation: Use consistent text plus icons across states and preserve a visible source timestamp.
assets.avoid: Treating the displayed freshness phrase as verified runtime evidence.
